title: brisk session record
description: What a harness knows about the session that produced a change. Passed to `brisk assess --session file.json`. Every field is optional; brisk treats the transcript as untrusted text.

session_id.description: Harness session ID, e.g. an Amp thread ID

intent.description: The task as the user stated it, up to ~2,000 characters

files_touched.description: Repo-relative paths the agent edited with its own tools (not through a generator). A generated file listed here is analysed as code and flagged.

commands.description: Shell commands the agent ran, oldest first. brisk recognises test, type-check, lint, and build commands itself.

excerpts.description: Transcript excerpts, oldest first. Keep the total under ~8,000 characters: the user's requests and corrections, and the agent's final summary.
